# Bitcoin-Price-Prediction-ML
## About
This project focuses on analyzing historical Bitcoin price data and predicting Bitcoin price movements using Machine Learning.

## Work Done
- Data collection and cleaning
- Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
- Data visualization
- Feature engineering
- Year-wise price analysis
- Price change 

## Technologies
- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Matplotlib
- Seaborn
- Scikit-learn

## Project Structure
- `data/` – Dataset
- `notebooks/` – Jupyter notebooks
- `images/` – Visualizations
- `models/` – Trained models
